L1.rule: at mu = 2 and 30 epochs, kept with the last layer retrained exceeds kept with the frame removed from the output by more than 0.05, in at least 4 tasks of 5

L2.rule: at mu = 2 and 90 epochs, the best of the two corrections keeps less than 0.9, in at least 4 tasks of 5

L3.rule: the best of the two corrections falls with mu (rank correlation not above -0.9) at both lengths, in at least 4 tasks of 5
